description: Exactly one review decision. For decision accept, include rationale and omit challenges. For decision challenge, include challenges and omit rationale.

decision.description: accept approves the reviewed proposal; challenge disputes it.

summary.description: Plain-text summary of the decision, 1 to 600 characters.

rationale.description: Plain-text reasoning, 1 to 900 characters. Required when decision is accept; must be omitted when decision is challenge.

challenges.description: 1 to 5 challenges. Required when decision is challenge; must be omitted when decision is accept.
